novelty_boundary.new_force_problem: a support surface moves upward into an unsupported descending body; the first toe contact acquires support while nonzero relative closing velocity remains, so the root must compress relative to the deck before the platform can carry it. Later platform braking changes support load without changing foot-contact topology.

keys.name: FIXED_LEDGE_READ
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body reads a moving platform far below/right while both feet own the fixed ledge.

keys.name: REAR_HEEL_LOAD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root sinks rearward as the platform advances and rises; asymmetry commits the eventual long diagonal flight.

keys.name: SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear leg spends fixed support and launches the root up-right; the platform remains an external moving support candidate, not magical air support.

keys.name: LONG_DIAGONAL_FLIGHT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Unsupported root travels strongly up-right while the platform rises beneath a different worldline.

keys.name: APEX_OPEN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Wide apex silhouette; limbs open while the platform continues upward-right independently.

keys.name: DESCENT_AIM
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root descends; right foot points toward the approaching deck while free-side arm trails to preserve asymmetry.

keys.name: UNDERCATCH_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right toe remains visibly separated one row above the rising deck; no support is granted before the authored contact key.

keys.name: LEAD_TOE_UNDERCATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: The rising deck reaches the descending right toe. Support is acquired exactly here while relative closing velocity is still nonzero.

keys.name: RELATIVE_VELOCITY_CRUSH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Deck rises faster than the root can follow; root-to-deck gap collapses into a deep one-foot crush while the free leg whips above deck.

keys.name: PLATFORM_CARRY_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support frame now carries the root up-right; torso and free-side limb lag back-left, paying the undercatch impulse with visible overshoot.

keys.name: TRAIL_HEEL_SHEAR_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Delayed trailing heel finally catches, creating a wide sheared base instead of instant symmetric dual support.

keys.name: LOADED_RISE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet remain on the moving deck but the left leg now drives a loaded rise; right-side hand lags behind the torso.

keys.name: PLATFORM_BRAKE_BODY_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Platform stops rising while foot topology stays dual. Load changes anyway; torso and hands overshoot relative to the support frame, proving topology is not load.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body settles at a new high/right address on the platform with a crooked right-dominant stack; no reverse interpolation or ledge-idle reset.
